svg.title: Codex Chat with an English–Chinese bilingual final reply
svg.desc: Illustrated example, not a screenshot. With Final answers only selected, the progress update stays in English. The final reply shows the English original followed by Chinese. Questions have a separate translation setting.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: Tell me when the tests and update are ready.
Final-only scope keeps progress in English.
FINAL REPLY · BOTH LANGUAGES IN THE CONVERSATION
The tests passed. The update is ready.
测试已通过。更新已准备就绪。
Translation appears below the original; no desktop reader is needed.
Default: Final answers only · Translate questions in chat: enabled
Choose All responses to translate visible progress updates too. Internal reasoning is not translated.
